questions.enonce_markdown: The interior angle of a regular polygon is $108^\circ$. Find the value of an exterior angle of this regular polygon.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Interior angle and exterior angle are on a straight line: $108^\circ + \text{exterior} = 180^\circ$.

Exterior angle $= 180^\circ - 108^\circ = 72^\circ$.

questions.enonce_markdown: Find the number of sides of this polygon.
questions.corrige_markdown:
The exterior angles of a polygon add up to $360^\circ$, and in a regular polygon they are all equal.

$n = \dfrac{360}{72} = 5$ sides.

questions.enonce_markdown: Write the special name of this regular polygon. *[5 marks for the whole question]*
questions.corrige_markdown: A regular polygon with 5 sides is a **regular pentagon**.
